questions.q: How many crotchet beats is a dotted minim worth?
questions.why: A minim is 2 beats and the dot adds half (1), so 3 beats.

questions.q: What type of time signature is 6/8?
questions.why: 6/8 has two beats per bar, each divided into three quavers.

questions.model: Syncopation is placing emphasis on weak beats or off-beats so the rhythm cuts across the main pulse.
points: accent/emphasis on weak beat or off-beat
